Pe.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra model (shaggy cream fleece, dark curled horns, blue accents) matches the owner bar and dwarfs the trainer at Palworld finish; side A's tumbled, dark-bellied faint frames are what pull it down.

Iu.bar_b_note: The pale blue-white wolf has naturalistic fur and a large readable silhouette over the trainer, but at small size the white-on-pale fur reads clumpy and the face and eyes get lost, so it lands just under the owner-bar wolves.

Cs.bar_b_note: Side A's black serpent with gold veins matches the Fulgocobra board and stays grounded, which carries it; side B sinks on hard yellow banding and a faint pose that rises upright and floats high above its own shadow.

Kh.bar_b_note: Side B's Tanglevolt keeps its violet-black storm fur through every pose at the owner-bar finish; side A's faint frames break into a white body with black blotches that reads as a different, untextured animal.

Sz.bar_b_note: A murky brown-green grade with no purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta ground rings as telegraphs, a tiny player creature and a dense HUD stacked over the left and bottom of the frame read as a debug capture, not a Palworld-class boss event.

Dm.bar_b_note: The same pale wolf model reads big, furry and grounded beside the trainer; on side B a fully airborne hit react and a face that blurs into white fur at small size hold it back.

Ih.bar_b_note: Side A's matte slate-and-tan Galecrest matches the owner-bar in-game bird and carries it; side B's bright, glossy white plumage looks plastic and blows out against the stage.

Ed.bar_b_note: The warm, friendly grandfather (white hair and beard, olive vest, green scarf, brown boots) uses an earthy palette that fits the Meadows settlement, but his big-eyed, smooth cartoon face sits more stylised than the naturalistic creatures beside him.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fight presentation: replace the flat magenta ground rings and slabs with real-object telegraphs (lightning bolts, crackling web, stone burst) that land with an impact; keep the camera clear of trunks and canopy (Sz A i11/i13/i15); grade in the fixed purple storm sky and white-violet lightning; slim the HUD stack so both fighters stay visible

Creature state-pose pass: keep both hind feet planted in every hit react (no full leaps: Iu A, Dm B), show every faint lying on its side facing the camera (Pe A), keep faint bodies on the ground (Cs B), and hold the same material on every state frame (Kh A faint frames lose their fur texture)

Matte material and board-palette pass: remove the glossy, over-bright whites and hard rim (Ih B), bring Cs B back to the Fulgocobra board's black-and-gold veining, and darken the pale wolf's face and eyes so they read at small size (Iu, Dm)
